hook: orphan 法律團推道具車：acquit／atone／chasten／arson——法官問「今天演宣判還是縱火紀錄片？」
script: acquit 無罪。atone 贖罪。chasten 懲戒。arson 縱火。abjudicate 判決。assoil 赦免。canvass 遊說拉票也常進政治法庭。口令：木槌寫「定罪或釋放」，火柴寫「別亂點」。

members.senseAnchor: pronounce not guilty of criminal charges; behave in a certain manner
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 釋放章: acquit walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「釋放章」出場：acquit 一上場梗就黏住——宣判無罪。

related.synonyms: assoil, clear, discharge, exonerate, exculpate, behave

members.senseAnchor: make amends for; turn away from sin or do penitence
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 贖罪箱: atone walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「贖罪箱」出場：atone 一上場梗就黏住——贖罪。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 戒尺: chasten walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「戒尺」出場：chasten 一上場梗就黏住——懲戒磨煉。

related.synonyms: chastise, castigate, objurgate, correct, moderate, temper

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 火柴盒: arson walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「火柴盒」出場：arson 一上場梗就黏住——縱火。
